family_reports.body: The greatest tragedy is that the abuse didn’t end at home—it continued through the system, leaving us trapped in a cycle of harm that the very institutions meant to protect us only deepened. Five years of litigation has left our family with lasting psychological trauma. We have lived in survival mode for so long that fear, uncertainty, and chronic stress became our normal. The financial devastation, emotional scars, and years we lost can never be restored. What began as a custody case changed every part of our lives, and its impact will remain with our family long after the case is over.
It has stolen memories and time with my children also my money

public_comments.comment_text: Denied motions, wouldn’t set hearings or hear motions filed by plaintiff. Gag orders. Punishment of not being able to see daughters games. It appears the judge and the attorneys all know each other and have a well played out system that destroys families.
